title: Give to Our God Immortal Praise
lyrics_original: Give to our God immortal praise;
Mercy and truth are all His ways:
Wonders of grace to God belong;
Repeat His mercies in your song.
Give to the Lord of Lords renown;
The King of Kings with glory crown:
His mercies ever shall endure,
When lords and kings are known no more.
He built the earth, He spread the sky,
And fixed the starry lights on high:
Wonders of grace to God belong;
Repeat His mercies in your song.
He fills the sun with morning light;
He bids the moon direct the night:
His mercies ever shall endure,
When suns and moons shall shine no more.
He sent His Son with pow'r to save
From guilt and darkness and the grave:
Wonders of grace to God belong;
Repeat His mercies in your song.
Through this vain world he guides our feet,
And leads us to his heav'nly seat:
His mercies ever shall endure,
When this vain world shall be no more.

bible_verses.english: Give thanks to Yahweh; for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.
He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”
All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

devotional.prayer_english: Creator God, I lift my voice to praise You for Your vast grandeur and Your gentle, enduring mercy. When everything around me shifts, thank You that Your love remains steadfast and true. Teach me to notice the wonders of Your grace each day and to live with a grateful heart. May my life continually echo Your goodness and honor You as my eternal King. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Look around at the vast beauty of creation and remember the God who carefully placed every star in the sky. Long after the kingdoms and leaders of this world fade away, His faithful love and truth endure forever. In every season of life, we are invited to anchor our hearts in His unfailing grace and echo His goodness through our worship. Let your heart rest in the King of Kings, whose mercy will never run out.
